To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the PNJL model is able to describe the phase diagram of the strongly interacting matter at finite temperature and density in β−equilibrated state, with a reasonable accuracy.

(i) The phase transition in 2+1 flavour strongly interacting matter in the presence of β−equilibrium is first order in the whole range of the temperature, (ii) The transition from hadron phase to quark matter phase is of second order for 2+1 quarks, and (iii) the transition from hadron to quark phase is first order for 2 quarks.
the Polyakov-Nambu-Jona Lasinio model is an effective tool in the study of strongly interacting matter in the β-equilibrium.
